title: Return to the Mall!
content: i’ve been wishing for ages to go back to the actual Mall and go roller skating. be careful what you wish for. i did indeed get to rollerskate round the Mall and it was every bit as satisfying as before. but then i had to do the entire journey ‘home’ (still not sure where that is) in roller boots. stairs, trains, sand paths, rough concrete. every time i looked for the right train platform i ended up caught in that endless loop of concrete steps and dead ends. again, semi-lucid. i remembered my way around and realised when i ended up in a dead-end stairwell. it was a complete return to Mall World! it was complicated and infuriating but i’m back!
